content.text: {"posting_id":"d82a0b31-59b8-4699-ae8d-6fb3fe47518c","claims":[{"kind":"role","claim":"The role is a software engineering role.","quote":"As an Android engineer, you’ll help build that native foundation, from how pages render and how people write and edit, to the navigation and app chrome people use every day, like Home, Search, and Inbox, along with the shared frameworks the rest of the app is built on.","proposed_label":"supported"},{"kind":"location","claim":"The job can be done in the US.","quote":"This role can be based in either San Francisco or New York City.","proposed_label":"supported"},{"kind":"experience","claim":"The role requires at most 2 years of experience.","quote":"You’ve built and shipped Android apps, through work, internships, or your own projects, and you’re comfortable with modern Android—Kotlin, Jetpack Compose, Coroutines/Flow, and Gradle.","proposed_label":"insufficient"},{"kind":"sponsorship","claim":"The employer will sponsor a work visa.","quote":"","proposed_label":"insufficient"},{"kind":"skill","claim":"The work uses TypeScript.","quote":"Web experience (TypeScript, React, Node) is welcome but not required.","proposed_label":"insufficient"},{"kind":"seniority","claim":"The role is open to entry-level candidates.","quote":"You’ve built and shipped Android apps, through work, internships, or your own projects, and you’re comfortable with modern Android—Kotlin, Jetpack Compose, Coroutines/Flow, and Gradle.","proposed_label":"insufficient"}]}
